about: The spec of each page, each state and each workflow of abhyasa after the consolidation. A test (tests.md) builds the data of each state with temp_learning() and fakes, GETs the page, and checks must_show, must_not_show and the links to exits. Element names are data-part (a section) and data-act (an action) attributes; tests select [data-part=X] and [data-act=Y]. Labels are the on-screen words (ASD-STE100). The repo copy (tests/data/flows.json) is the source of truth; the design copy is history. An item is `kind:value`: part:X and act:Y check the first word of the value, label: checks the words (with {name} from the builder), one:X checks that exactly one [data-part=X] shows. Words after the first in part: and act: are a note. A state or a workflow with "pending": true has no code yet, and the test skips it.

data.about: The stored fields that decide each state. store: where the field lives. new: true when the field does not exist today.

walk.current.store: walk_state(j, by).current (derived; None when every step is done, skipped or known)

walk.here.store: lr.journey(jid)['here'] = {step, at}; written by GET of the idea page

walk.jobs.research.store: lr.journey(jid)['jobs']['research'] = {state: running|done|stopped|failed|closed, start, end, have, total, why, seen} — built as the row walk:<jid>:research of `jobs`
walk.jobs.research.replaces: research_start, research_end, gather_at, gather_end, research_seen, research_stopped, and Researcher.running() for the page

walk.jobs.build.store: lr.journey(jid)['jobs']['build'] = {state, said, start, end, why} — built as the row build:<hash> of `jobs`

walk.jobs.filing.store: lr.journey(jid)['jobs']['filing'] = {state, roots, why} — built as the row walk:<jid>:filing of `jobs`

walk.steps[i].qid.store: lr.journey(jid).steps[i]['qid']; open when qid in tutor.open (runtime; the fixture opens it with GET /check)

course.jobs.store: lr.course(cid)['jobs'][kind] = {state, said, start, end, why}; kind level|plan|stage:<key> — built as the row course:<cid>:<kind> of `jobs`

course_state.store: course_state(lr, cid) (derived): here, next, blocking, finished

session.open.store: lr.session(sid): log is not None and not ended and (log or open)

walk.data.store: lr.journey(jid)['data'] = [{path, note}]; your data folders, from the course, Add a source (My data) or the Start box (My data). The walk page shows them under part:sources as part:data, with ×

jobs.store: lr.jobs()[key] = {kind, state: running|done|failed|stopped|closed, title, said, start, end, url, obj, why, seen, quiet}: the job ledger of the vault file (vishalakshi Vault.ledger, through abhyasa.jobs), so the rows survive a restart
jobs.keys: walk:<jid>:research, walk:<jid>:filing, walk:<jid>:nb:<slug>, build:<hash> (a link or goal walk), course:<cid>:<level|plan|stage key>, demo:<slug>[:<aim>][#<ask key>] (a demo or a 3D explainer; quiet when it starts by itself: the demo of a step, a simpler demo, the demo after a miss), lesson:<slug> (a rung of the demo ladder; quiet), improve:<jid>:<hash> (Improve the walk), talk:<jid or tid> (Present, Fill the slides, Make it again), sort:<sid> (Sort my concepts), download:<model> (a model in Settings). Each part that waits for one of them has data-job=<key> and loads again on its event, with a fallback poll of 30 s

walk.steps[i].locked.store: lr.journey(jid).steps[i]['locked'] = True: Lock (Keep this idea) on the plan. Improve and Fix the rest never change, move or remove it; a hand edit unlocks it, and Undo locks it again

course.stages[k].locked.store: lr.course(cid)['stages'][k]['locked'] = True: Lock on the course page. A replan and Fix the rest keep the stage and its walk as they are. Fix the rest also keeps each stage whose walk you started (walk.started, or a step done or shaky), because a replan has no Undo

course.origin.store: lr.course(cid)['origin'] = {slug, walk, step, idea, title, at, back_at} or {slug, page, title, at, back_at}

concept.size.store: lr.concept(slug)['size']: the ideas that it builds on, from the tutor when it adds a term (name_gaps)

side_walk.parent.page.store: lr.journey(sid)['parent'] = {page: '/c/<slug>'} for a side walk from a concept page

continue.rule: last_place(lr) gives one place or None. A place is (walk, step) or (session). Candidates: (1) each walk that is not for a talk and has walk.current not None; a side walk counts as the step of its parent (walk.parent); its time is max(walk.here.at, the newest steps[i].read_at, walk.started). (2) each open session with no journey; its time is session.updated. The newest candidate wins. The step of a walk place is walk.here.step when that step is not done, else walk.current.
continue.show_when: place is not None AND the page is not the place's walk (/w/{jid} or /w/{jid}/{i} with the same jid, or the parent walk of a side walk) AND the page is not Home (Home shows the same place as its card) AND the page is not a review session.

continue.one_function: The top bar, the Home card and the course card call last_place. history.continue_link, history.continue_card and the course today_top card are replaced by it.
continue.cost: One query per page: the newest 10 walks by updated, and the newest open session. No progress() over all concepts.

activity.rule: abhyasa.jobs.activity(lr): the rows with state running, then the rows with state done, failed or closed that are not seen and ended less than 6 hours ago. A quiet row (a side walk of a talk, a notebook spec, the demo of a step, a rung of the demo ladder) never shows.

sections.plan: the ideas in order, each with its check kind. Edit in place: move, skip, remove, check kind, add, split, merge, rewrite, with Undo. Each idea has a quiet Lock toggle (Keep this idea): a locked idea shows a small lock mark, and Improve and Fix the rest never change, move or remove it. An edit by hand unlocks it, with Undo. 'Earlier versions' is a fold.
sections.sources: the research line (state of walk.jobs.research), Stop, Show what it did (pane), Find sources again, Add a source, what Start filed with Undo
sections.result: after the end: what moved, what you made (Leela), the next review date
sections.talks: quiet: Present, Open the talk (secondary product)
sections.improve: a quiet fold 'Improve the walk' (closed until you open it) with one box 'What should change?' and chips Simpler, Harder, Add an idea (and From your weak ideas on a finished walk). A link in the box is a source: abhyasa files it. The tutor proposes changes with the editor ops only (add with a source, remove, skip, move, split, an easier or a harder check), each with a one-line why; you Keep or Skip each one, then Apply the kept changes, as one change with Undo. Next to Ask the tutor: Fix the rest. The tutor redoes only the ideas that are not locked (their order, their checks, and the ideas that are missing between them), with the words in the box, in the same proposal (Keep or Skip, then Apply, with one Undo).

demos.about: One idea: Explain and Show. Explain = the tutor talks and marks what you already see, and builds a small concrete example from those values in the side panel at the top right (board.js). Show = a thing that you act on or watch (a rupaka spec), in the Show slot of the idea, or in the same top-right place on a page with no slot. Show never says no: with no demo yet, it makes one, and the card shows the plan while it waits. Code that runs is Leela.

explain.what: board: steps with marks (circle, underline, arrow, label, point, sketch) and one spoken line each, and the side panel: rows built from the values on screen, one row in each step, each linked to its thing on the page by a circle and a curve
explain.renderer: rupaka.board: board.js (marks and the side panel), board.css and paper.css (the paper)

predict.what: 2D rupaka spec, mode predict: you predict at each gate, then you see

explainer.what: 3D rupaka scene, mode learn: it builds one step at a time; no prediction

video.renderer: Show slot embed; board op video_at seeks it

notebook.moves_floor: only when Leela files a passed check

panel.what: the side panel of Explain: a title, a head, column names, rows (cells → answer), chain rows and a note; a new panel line is a new beat. A process is a panel with numbered rows
panel.renderer: board.js placePanel; later a rupaka learn spec grown with Rupaka.append (rupaka ask)

demos.one_engine: demo.show(tutor, concept, words, where, kind, ask, aim, values) → ask row + job; one card ShowCard(ask) with one label (2D demo, 3D explainer, Leela notebook), its plan while it waits, the 2D demo while 3D builds. /demo/make and /demo/wait are gone; /demo/ask and /demo/asked/{aid} stay.
demos.events: Each Show and each board writes one row with lr.put_ask (where, kind, said, slug). course rule 3 reads them: two or more on one idea and no right check since → check it now.
demos.stuck_order: On an open short check: Hint, Explain, Show me (⌥E), Teach me (or I don't know); the side walk is Learn it. One Show me button on the idea page: in the row of the open check, else under the title.
